name: dc-ecommerce
description: Digital Store - e-commerce Full Stack educacional (React + Node.js/Express) desenvolvido na Digital College.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
